votes.quote: The current implementation in `src/globToRegex.ts` just replaces `**` with `.*` unconditionally (lines 6-13), without special-casing the following `/`. That means: `**/yarn.lock` fails to match `yarn.lock` (no leading `/` in the input, but the regex requires one before the literal text)

votes.label: reported
votes.quote: Per spec.md: when `**` is immediately followed by `/`, that `/` should be consumed as optional, so `**/yarn.lock` matches `yarn.lock` at the root and `a/**/b` matches `a/b`. The current implementation in `src/globToRegex.ts` just replaces `**` with `.*` unconditionally (lines 6-13), without special-casing the following `/`.
